title: MoDDiT: Simple Token Routing in Diffusion Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.28086v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-time video generation, interactive world models, and on-device image synthesis are almost a reality. Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve excellent sample quality, shifting the bottleneck to the throughput of the models themselves. Natural images are inherently sparse, as large portions of an image are often background, contribute little to the scene content, and are easy to denoise. DiTs fail to exploit this sparsity, as they process image tokens statically and uniformly. We propose MoDDiT, a simple architecture modification that learns to route tokens through both MLP and self-attention operations. By routing tokens through both blocks independently, MoDDiT allows for dynamic compute allocation in MLPs that varies across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps. Using MoDDiT to train image generation models from scratch significantly reduces computational costs of training and inference, processing as few as 12.5% of the tokens.

translated_title: MoDDiT：扩散Transformer中的简单令牌路由
translated_abstract: 实时视频生成、交互式世界模型和端侧图像合成几乎已成为现实。扩散Transformer（DiT）实现了出色的样本质量，从而将瓶颈转移到了模型自身的吞吐量上。自然图像本质上是稀疏的，因为图像的大部分通常是背景，对场景内容贡献很小，且容易去噪。然而DiT未能利用这种稀疏性，因为它们以静态且统一的方式处理图像令牌。我们提出了MoDDiT，这是一种简单的架构修改，它学会将令牌分别路由通过MLP和自注意力操作。通过将令牌独立地路由通过这两个模块，MoDDiT能够在MLP中实现跨令牌、跨图像以及跨去噪时间步变化的动态计算分配。使用MoDDiT从头训练图像生成模型可显著降低训练和推理的计算成本，仅需处理少至12.5%的令牌。
tldr: MoDDiT通过对扩散Transformer进行简单的架构修改，让令牌独立路由通过MLP和自注意力模块，实现跨令牌、图像和去噪时间步的动态计算分配，仅需处理12.5%的令牌即可显著降低图像生成模型训练与推理的计算成本。
en_tdlr: MoDDiT is a simple architecture modification for diffusion transformers that routes tokens independently through MLP and self-attention blocks, enabling dynamic compute allocation across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps, which reduces training and inference costs by processing as few as 12.5% of the tokens.
